label: CPS counter
description: Clicks per second over a sliding window.
settings_description: Settings for the CPS counter HUD mod. Derived entirely in JS from mouse edges on the `keys` event (§3), so no Java sensor exists for it.

mode.description: Which mouse buttons to count: left only, right only, or both shown side by side.

show_label.description: Whether to render the trailing "CPS" unit after the figures. Every other readout on the HUD can drop its unit; this one could not, which left it the widest chip on screen for a player who already knows what the number is.

window_ms.description: Length of the sliding window in milliseconds over which clicks are counted before being scaled to clicks per second.
